content: Hi how can i assist you today
Emails from a colleague arrive right when I think of them. It’s uncanny.
Some teams use scheduled send times or respond after regular meetings. Do those messages cluster around certain hours or right after shared events?
Often just after our weekly standup ends.
Post-meeting follow-ups are common. Time-zone overlaps and delay-send features can also stack messages at predictable minutes.
He’s in a different zone; his noon is my 7 p.m.
That offset can make arrivals feel synchronized with your thoughts at day's end.
When he’s on vacation, the effect stops.
Which tracks with sender availability rather than mind reading.
The timing lines up with routine, then.
